## Checklist

- [ ] The change is in `library/entries/` (or below a skill's end-of-generated-part marker), and `make render` was run
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Every new source is primary, resolves, and is quoted with its own numbers and conditions
- [ ] A line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Tried in Claude Code with `claude --plugin-dir .` (for a change to how a skill works)
